import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time columns to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['time'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['time']).dt.time

# Create a bar chart to show the distribution of coffee sales by product
product_sales = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['quantity'].sum().reset_index()
sns.set()
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='quantity', data=product_sales)
plt.title('Coffee Sales by Product')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Quantity')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

payment_method_counts = coffee_sales['payment_method'].value_counts().reset_index()

plt.pie(payment_method_counts['payment_method'], labels=payment_method_counts['index'], autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Distribution of Payment Methods')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('payment_methods.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
